label: In a conservation area
description: Site is in or partly in a conservation area (planning.data.gov.uk dataset conservation-area).

label: Listed building
description: Site is, or contains, a listed building or is within its curtilage (dataset listed-building).

label: Near a listed building
description: The proposal could affect the setting of a listed building.

label: Locally listed
description: Site is or contains a locally listed (non-designated) heritage asset (dataset locally-listed-building).

label: World Heritage Site
description: Site is in a World Heritage Site (MHCLG use this value in design-and-access-statement; dataset world-heritage-site).

label: Archaeology area
description: Site is in an area of archaeological potential or priority (dataset archaeological-priority-area).

label: Flood zone 2 or 3
description: Site is in Environment Agency flood zone 2 or 3 (dataset flood-risk-zone).

label: TPO trees
description: Site has trees protected by a tree preservation order (dataset tree-preservation-zone).

label: National Landscape
description: Site is in an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty / National Landscape (dataset area-of-outstanding-natural-beauty).

label: SSSI on or near site
description: Site is in or next to a Site of Special Scientific Interest (dataset site-of-special-scientific-interest).

label: Near an SPA
description: Site is in the zone of influence of a Special Protection Area (dataset special-protection-area).

label: In the Green Belt
description: Site is in the Green Belt (dataset green-belt).

label: Coal mining risk
description: Site is in a Coal Authority development high risk area.

label: Contaminated land
description: Site is known or suspected to be contaminated.

label: Nutrient catchment
description: Site is in a catchment where Natural England advise nutrient neutrality.

label: Water neutrality zone
description: Site is in a zone where water neutrality is required (e.g. Sussex North).

label: Air quality area
description: Site is in an air quality management area.

label: New vehicle access
description: The proposal creates or alters a vehicle access onto a road.

label: Trees on or near site
description: There are trees on the site or close enough to be affected (including street trees).

label: Basement
description: The proposal includes a new or enlarged basement.

label: Includes demolition
description: The proposal involves demolishing a building or part of one.

label: External lighting
description: The proposal includes external or flood lighting.

label: Illuminated advert
description: The advertisement is illuminated.

label: Loss of a use
description: The proposal would lose an existing employment, community, retail or similar use.

label: Food or drink use
description: The proposal is for a food or drink use, or includes ventilation or extraction plant.

label: Structural alterations
description: The proposal involves structural alterations (for example to a listed building).

label: Building height (m)
description: Height of the tallest proposed building in metres.

label: Storeys
description: Number of storeys in the tallest proposed building.

label: Plant or extraction
description: The proposal includes plant, ventilation, air extraction or air conditioning equipment, or flues.

label: Noisy use
description: The proposal is for a use likely to create significant noise (food and drink, entertainment, industrial, nursery, place of worship, school...).

label: Noise-sensitive use
description: A noise-sensitive use (such as homes) is proposed in a noisy environment.

label: Ground works
description: The proposal involves a new building, excavation or other disturbance of the ground.

label: New-build
description: The proposal includes newly built floorspace or dwellings rather than only conversion.

label: EIA development
description: The development needs an Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA Regulations 2017).

label: Educational housing
description: The proposal includes educational accommodation (for example student halls or boarding).

label: Change of use
description: The proposal changes the use of land or buildings (including conversions).

label: Shopfront
description: The proposal includes a new or altered shopfront.

label: Biomass boiler or CHP
description: The proposal includes a biomass boiler or combined heat and power plant.

label: Substantial earthworks
description: The proposal involves substantial earthworks or demolition.

label: Substantial demolition
description: The proposal involves substantial demolition of a building.

label: House extension
description: The proposal extends or alters a house (rear extension, conservatory, dormer, roof works...).

label: In a protected view
description: Site is in a protected view or viewing corridor (for example London View Management Framework).

label: Local wildlife site
description: Site is in or next to a local wildlife site, local nature reserve or nature conservation area (SNCI, LNR, SINC).

label: Critical drainage area
description: Site is in a critical drainage area or local flood risk area identified by the council.

label: Article 4 area
description: Site is covered by an Article 4 direction (dataset article-4-direction-area).

label: Traffic increase %
description: Increase in road traffic movements as a percentage of Annual Average Daily Traffic. (first used by CMD)

label: Ancient woodland
description: Site is in Ancient Woodland or its buffer zone. (first used by CRW)

label: Bedrooms
description: Number of bedrooms proposed (for example in student accommodation or a house in multiple occupation). (first used by OXO)

label: BNG applies
description: The development is subject to the statutory biodiversity gain condition (Schedule 7A, Town and Country Planning Act 1990), i.e. it is not exempt. (first used by DAR)

label: Building works
description: The proposal involves building works (new buildings, extensions or alterations), including works for a change of use. (first used by GRA)

label: Car-free development
description: The proposal is car-free (no general car parking is provided). (first used by MRT)

label: Level changes
description: The proposal changes ground or floor levels, or the site slopes. (first used by GOS)

label: Coastal erosion zone
description: Site is in a coastal erosion zone or coastal change management area identified by the council. (first used by SWL)

label: Plan departure
description: The application is advertised as a departure from the development plan. (first used by HAS)

label: Designated Rural Area
description: Site is in a Designated Rural Area (Housing Act 1985 s157), where lower affordable housing thresholds apply. (first used by CHI)

label: External works
description: The proposal includes external works or alterations to a building. (first used by LEW)

label: Floodlighting
description: The proposal includes floodlighting (for example of sports pitches or games areas). (first used by RDB)

label: Bigger footprint
description: The proposal increases the built footprint on the site. (first used by BRY)

label: Greenfield site
description: The site is greenfield land (not previously developed). (first used by IOW)

label: Ground floor/basement
description: The proposal relates to a basement and/or ground floor level (used with flood risk triggers). (first used by HMF)

label: Height change
description: The proposal raises a roof or changes the height of a building, including floor-to-ceiling heights. (first used by BRY)

label: Large minor
description: The proposal falls within the council's 'large minor' size band (the larger minor developments, as the council's list defines it). (first used by CRY)

label: Local character area
description: Site is in a locally designated character area, such as an Area of Special Local Character or Area of Townscape Character. (first used by CRW)

label: Loss of open space
description: The proposal would result in the loss of open space or recreational land. (first used by KTT)

label: Minor development
description: The proposal is minor development: it creates dwellings or floorspace below the major development thresholds (or falls within the council's own 'minor' size band). (first used by CRY)

label: Near a landfill site
description: Site is within the council's buffer distance (often 250m) of an existing or former landfill site. (first used by EHA)

label: Near a watercourse
description: The development is close to a main river or ordinary watercourse (the council sets the distance). (first used by ENF)

label: New boundary treatment
description: The proposal includes new or altered boundary walls, fences or gates. (first used by BRY)

label: Open space
description: Site is existing open space, playing fields or sports and recreational land or buildings. (first used by BEX)

label: Out-of-centre use
description: The proposal is for a main town centre use (retail, leisure, offices and similar) at an edge-of-centre or out-of-centre location, outside a defined town centre or primary shopping area. (first used by ADU)

label: Outside urban area
description: The site is outside the main urban area or settlement boundary defined in the local plan. (first used by MAI)

label: Historic park/garden
description: Site is in, or in the setting of, a registered historic park or garden (dataset park-and-garden). (first used by CHI)

label: Parking change
description: The proposal increases, reduces or alters parking provision. (first used by DOV)

label: New parking spaces
description: Number of new parking spaces proposed. (first used by EHA)

label: Brownfield
description: The site is previously developed (brownfield) land. (first used by BDG)

label: Priority habitat
description: Site contains or adjoins a priority habitat (Natural England Priority Habitats Inventory). (first used by ELM)

label: Protected species
description: The proposal is likely to affect protected or priority species or their habitats. (first used by CHI)

label: Extra pupils
description: The increase in school pupil numbers the proposal would allow. (first used by WSX)

label: In a regeneration area
description: Site is within a regeneration or area action plan area identified by the council. (first used by ADU)

label: Residential annexe
description: The proposal includes a residential annexe. (first used by CHI)

label: Retail m²
description: Gross new or additional retail floorspace proposed, in square metres. (first used by EHA)

label: Roof alteration
description: The proposal changes the shape of an existing roof or adds a new roof. (first used by ARU)

label: In the rural area
description: Site is in the rural area as defined by the council's local plan (outside the urban area or settlement boundaries). (first used by GRA)

label: Scheduled monument
description: Site contains or affects a scheduled monument or its setting (dataset scheduled-monument). (first used by BDG)

label: School expansion
description: School development that increases pupil and/or staff numbers (including temporary and bulge classes). (first used by SRY)

label: Sensitive end use
description: The proposal is for a sensitive end use such as housing, schools or nurseries (for example on or near contaminated land). (first used by DOV)

label: Level change (mm)
description: The largest change to existing ground levels proposed, in millimetres. (first used by ARU)

label: Source Protection Zone
description: Site is in an Environment Agency groundwater Source Protection Zone or a Drinking Water Safeguard Zone. (first used by BUC)

label: Near an SAC
description: Site is in or near a Special Area of Conservation (dataset special-area-of-conservation). (first used by DAR)

label: Staff
description: Number of staff (employees) the development will accommodate. (first used by MRT)

label: Strategic site
description: Site is within a strategic development allocation or new settlement named in the local plan (for example Welborne). (first used by FAR)

label: Surface water flood
description: Site is at risk of surface water flooding (Environment Agency risk of flooding from surface water). (first used by LEW)

label: Telecoms
description: The proposal is for telecommunications equipment (masts, antennas, cabinets and similar). (first used by ADU)

label: Town centre use m²
description: Gross new or additional floorspace for main town centre uses (as defined in the NPPF), in square metres. (first used by RDG)

label: Upper-floor extension
description: The proposal extends or alters a building above ground-floor level. (first used by EPS)

label: Veteran trees
description: There are ancient or veteran trees on or next to the site. (first used by CRW)
Our key: what a document must contain or show (list of item / level / optional required-if / source-text).
example: must-include: [{item: Scale and north point, level: must}]

description: Our key: where the council says it (link to the council's list).
Our key: the council's own wording, verbatim.
Our key: the local policy the council cites, if any.
Our key: high / medium / low confidence in the file.
Our key: anything else (also holds the Markdown body text of MHCLG files).
Our key: worked out by scripts; the lowest status of the file's cells.
Our key: one review mark per cell (written by scripts).
Our key, in _lpa.yaml: council-wide rules for every document.

label: Officer discretion
description: Our value for required-if: the council asks for it "where appropriate" or at officer discretion, with no threshold.
Our key, in _lpa.yaml: when the council was emailed to check its entry (sent, reply-by, to). Written by scripts/right_of_reply.py.
Our key, inside a field-status mark: the council list (url, date) a human-verified or incorrect cell was compared with.
Our key, inside a field-status mark: the GitHub account that made the mark (from the pull request for review mode).

label: Community consulted
description: The applicant consulted the local community before submitting the application. (first used by GED)

label: External space
description: The proposal includes external space around buildings (gardens, open areas, parking or other outdoor areas). (first used by HAO)

label: Settlement population
description: Population of the settlement the site is in (some councils set lower affordable housing thresholds for small settlements). (first used by HIG)

label: Renewable energy
description: The proposal is for renewable or low carbon energy generation (for example solar or wind) or electricity grid infrastructure. (first used by MAS)

label: HER entry
description: The site has an entry in the county Historic Environment Record (HER). (first used by NWL)

label: Office m²
description: Gross new or additional office floorspace proposed, in square metres. (first used by SHO)

label: Industrial m²
description: Gross new or additional industrial floorspace proposed, in square metres. (first used by SHO)

label: Warehouse m²
description: Gross new or additional warehousing (storage and distribution) floorspace proposed, in square metres. (first used by SHO)

label: Peak-hour trips
description: Traffic movements an hour the development is expected to generate at peak times. (first used by BRO)

label: Daily trips
description: Traffic movements over 24 hours the development is expected to generate. (first used by BRO)

label: Losing trees/hedges
description: The proposal involves the loss of trees, removal of a hedge, or filling in a natural pond or ditch. (first used by BRO)

label: Battery energy storage
description: The proposal includes a battery energy storage system. (first used by BRO)

label: Dark sky area
description: Site is in a designated dark sky area, such as an International Dark Sky Reserve or Park or a planning authority's dark sky zone. (first used by BROADS)

label: New hard surfacing
description: The proposal includes new or replacement hard surfacing (for example a driveway or patio). (first used by HER)

label: Wind turbine
description: The proposal includes one or more wind turbines. (first used by HYN)

label: Wind turbines
description: Number of wind turbines proposed. (first used by NDE)

label: Turbine hub height (m)
description: Hub height of the proposed wind turbine(s), in metres. (first used by NDE)

label: Future flood risk
description: Site is shown at increased risk of flooding in future: in 'Flood Zones plus climate change' on the flood map for planning, or at increased risk during its lifetime in the council's strategic flood risk assessment (SFRA). (first used by MSS)

label: Non-mains drainage
description: The proposal relies on non-mains (private) foul drainage, such as a septic tank or package treatment plant. (first used by MSS)

label: Drainage works
description: The proposal alters the existing sewerage system or creates a new drainage system. (first used by MSS)

label: Affordable housing shortfall
description: The proposed affordable housing provision falls short of the council's policy target (for example 34%). (first used by TAN)

label: Footprint change
description: The proposal changes the footprint of a building on the site (new, extended, reduced or removed). (first used by REI)

label: Comparison retail m²
description: Gross new or additional comparison retail floorspace (non-food goods such as clothing and household items), in square metres. (first used by REI)

label: Convenience retail m²
description: Gross new or additional convenience retail floorspace (everyday goods such as food), in square metres. (first used by REI)

label: Landscaping works
description: The proposal includes new soft and/or hard landscaping. (first used by WEA)

label: Visible from a highway
description: The proposed extension or works can be seen from a highway. (first used by BNH)

label: Industrial site
description: The site is, or has been, in industrial use. (first used by BNH)

label: Next to woodland
description: The site is next to an area of woodland. (first used by FAR)

label: Direct air emissions
description: The proposal involves an energy facility or industrial processes with direct emissions into the air. (first used by STH)

label: Overnight accommodation
description: The proposal creates overnight accommodation other than dwellings, such as a hotel. (first used by STH)

label: More HMO occupants
description: The proposal increases the number of occupants of a house in multiple occupation (HMO). (first used by STH)

label: Hedgerows affected
description: Hedgerows would be lost or affected by the development or its construction. (first used by STH)

label: All-affordable scheme
description: The site is proposed and justified in principle on the basis of delivering only (rented) affordable housing, for example to meet priority local needs. (first used by DAR)

label: Obligations shortfall
description: The proposal does not offer the full range of planning obligations (affordable housing and other contributions) that policy requires. (first used by DAR)

label: CIL liable
description: The development is liable for the Community Infrastructure Levy (CIL Regulations 2010). (first used by DAR)

label: National park
description: Site is in or next to a national park (dataset national-park). (first used by WOT)

label: Site allocation
description: The site is within a site allocation in the local plan. (first used by WOT)

label: Registered battlefield
description: Site is in or affects the setting of a registered battlefield (dataset battlefield). (first used by DOV)

label: Ramsar site
description: Site is in, or could directly or indirectly affect, a Ramsar wetland site (dataset ramsar). (first used by MDW)

label: National nature reserve
description: Site is in or next to a National Nature Reserve (dataset national-nature-reserve). (first used by CRY)

label: Vacant building
description: The proposal converts a building that is currently vacant. (first used by CRY)

label: Room in roof space
description: The proposal creates a new room in the roof space (for example a loft conversion). (first used by MDW)

label: Advert on a building
description: The advertisement is to be displayed on an existing building or structure. (first used by THA)

label: Settlement tier
description: The tier of the settlement the site is in, in the local plan's settlement hierarchy (for example market-town or larger-village), where thresholds differ by tier. (first used by SDNPA)

label: Neighbourhood plan area
description: Site is in a designated neighbourhood plan area named by the council's list (for example Emsworth), where the neighbourhood plan adds requirements. (first used by HAA)

label: Protected wreck site
description: Site is in or affects a protected wreck site (dataset protected-wreck-site). (first used by DOV)

label: Fails the basic BRE daylight tests
description: The development fails the basic BRE 45 degree and/or 25 degree daylight tests in relation to neighbouring properties. (first used by SHE)

label: Raised platform
description: The proposal includes a raised platform, such as decking or a terrace. (first used by SHE)

label: Town centre
description: The site is within a defined town centre boundary in the local plan. (first used by RUN)

label: Site layout change
description: A variation of a condition changes the site layout of the approved development. (first used by WOK)

label: Floor layout change
description: A variation of a condition changes the floor plans of the approved development. (first used by WOK)

label: Shopping frontage
description: Site is within a primary, secondary or local shopping frontage (or protected retail frontage) defined in the local plan. (first used by GRE)

label: Groundwater flood risk
description: Site is in an area at risk of groundwater flooding identified by the council, such as a throughflow or groundwater policy zone or an area with 25% or more susceptibility to groundwater flooding. (first used by RIC)

label: Changes approved plans
description: The application (for example a variation of condition) changes the approved plans. (first used by RDG)

label: Distance to neighbour (m)
description: Shortest distance, in metres, from the proposed building to the common boundary with a neighbouring residential property. (first used by BAN)

label: Farm building reuse
description: The proposal is for farm diversification or the reuse, conversion or alteration of agricultural buildings such as barns. (first used by BAN)

label: Rural exception housing
description: The application is for rural exception (rural exceptions site) affordable housing. (first used by EHA)

label: Affordable housing proposed
description: The proposal includes affordable housing (for example a rural exception scheme), or regenerates existing affordable housing schemes or properties. (first used by HAT)

label: Air quality screening area
description: Site is in an area where the council's air quality guidance requires applications to be screened for an air quality assessment (for example in or within 1km of the Winchester settlement area in its Air Quality SPD). (first used by WIN)

label: Hotel
description: The proposal includes new hotel development. (first used by WIN)

label: CIL relief claimed
description: The applicant is claiming Community Infrastructure Levy relief, such as Charitable Relief or Social Housing Relief. (first used by WIN)

label: Outside the main town
description: The site is outside the district's main town as the local plan defines it (for example outside Winchester Town), where lower size thresholds can apply. (first used by WIN)

label: Operational development
description: The proposal involves (or, for an existing-use certificate, involved) operational development such as building or engineering works, rather than only a use. (first used by TES)

label: Freestanding advert
description: The advertisement is freestanding or not fixed to a building shown on the site plan. (first used by TES)

label: Geodiversity interest
description: The development may affect features of geodiversity and soils interest. (first used by EAT)

label: Departs from parking standards
description: The development deviates from the council's adopted parking standards. (first used by EAT)

label: Outbuilding
description: The proposal includes a new outbuilding or alters or extends an existing one (for example a garden building). (first used by EPS)

label: Church curtilage
description: The works are within the curtilage of a church. (first used by ELM)

label: New open space
description: The proposal provides new public or communal open space. (first used by ELM)

label: Off-site BNG
description: Biodiversity net gain is to be provided wholly or partly off site (off-site land or statutory credits). (first used by ELM)

label: Class E m²
description: Gross new floorspace in Use Class E (commercial, business and service) from operational development or change of use, in square metres. (first used by KTT)

label: Next to noise-sensitive use
description: The site is adjacent to existing noise-sensitive development (such as homes). (first used by EAS)

label: HMO occupants
description: Number of occupants (persons) the proposed house in multiple occupation (HMO) is for. (first used by MAI)

label: Dwelling subdivided
description: The proposal converts (subdivides) a single dwelling into two or more flats or dwellings. (first used by MAI)

label: BNG exemption claimed
description: The applicant argues that the development is exempt from the biodiversity gain condition. (first used by MAI)

label: Use class
description: The use class or use type of the proposed development, named as in the council's list (for example drinking-establishment, hot-food-takeaway, financial-professional-services, business, restaurant-cafe, hospital-nursing-home, residential-education, institutional-hostel, former-d1, former-d2). Used with floorspace or residential-capacity for use-specific thresholds. (first used by MOL)
example: all: [{condition: {field: use-class, value: hot-food-takeaway}}, {condition: {field: floorspace, operator: '>', value: 500}}]

label: Beds, students or residents
description: Number of beds, students or residents a residential institution (Use Class C2, such as a hospital, nursing home, residential school or hostel) will accommodate. (first used by MOL)

label: Lighting unit height (m)
description: Height above ground of the tallest proposed external lighting unit, in metres. (first used by MOL)

label: Former district
description: The former district council area the site is in, for a unitary council whose list still has parts for some former districts. For Somerset: mendip (East area), sedgemoor (North area), south-somerset (South area), taunton-deane or west-somerset (together the West area, the former Somerset West and Taunton). For Dorset: east-dorset, north-dorset, purbeck, west-dorset or weymouth-and-portland (used where Dorset Council's list cites a former district's local plan). (first used by SUA)

label: Existing affordable housing site
description: The proposal is development of a site that currently holds affordable housing. (first used by EDE)

label: Listed building works
description: The kind of works a listed building consent application is for, named as in the council's list. For East Devon: thatching, re-roofing, replacement-windows, render, shopfront, internal-alterations, flues-vents, structural-demolition. (first used by EDE)

label: Floorspace increase (%)
description: Additional gross internal floorspace from an extension, as a percentage of the existing building's gross internal floorspace. (first used by DST)

label: Landfill development
description: The proposal is for landfill or the infilling of land with waste. (first used by SUA)

label: Dewatering or abstraction
description: The proposal involves dewatering or water abstraction (for example at a quarry or landfill). (first used by SUA)

label: Landscape character area
description: Site is within or directly adjacent to a Landscape Character Area defined in the council's landscape character assessment. (first used by PLY)

label: Night-time servicing
description: The proposal enables deliveries or waste collection during the night-time period (for example between 11pm and 7am). (first used by PLY)

label: Distance to noise-sensitive use (m)
description: Shortest distance, in metres, from the site to an existing noise-sensitive (for example residential) use. (first used by PLY)

label: Underground storage tanks
description: The proposal involves decommissioning or removing underground storage tanks (for example fuel tanks). (first used by PLY)

label: Floorspace change
description: The proposal or amendment changes the amount of floorspace being created (for example a non-material amendment that alters the floor space of an approved scheme). (first used by SOX)
